training_counts: Each path saves gates, nonzero readout basis, gate-and-basis, zero requests, hidden/export changes, coefficient/output clips, paired q2 changes, maximum observed RA, signed/squared rear reconstruction residual at current old state. Observed max is not a continuous-domain bound.
freeze: Refuse existing output; copy both inherited protocols, SHA256 all executable sources and local experiment definitions before any run. Long run requires passed preflight with identical fingerprints. Keep failures; no change of gates/steps/width/cases/seeds/checkpoints/horizon to improve outcomes.
